question: The unit's digit in (263)¹⁴⁹ + (263)¹⁵⁰ + (263)¹⁵¹ is:
solution:
Given:

(263)149 + (263)150 + (263)151

Concept used:

Cyclicity of 3 = 4

Calculation:

Remainder when 149 is divided by 3's cyclicity i.e. 4 = 1

Remainder when 150 is divided by 3's cyclicity i.e. 4 = 2

Remainder when 151 is divided by 3's cyclicity i.e. 4 = 3

So, the unit digits of (263)149 + (263)150 + (263)151

⇒ Unit place digits of (3¹ + 3² + 3³)

⇒ Unit place digits of 39

⇒ 9

**∴ The unit's digit in (263)149 + (263)150 + (263)151 is 9.**
